data: Apple's fiscal 2023 results show a modest contraction from fiscal 2022. Revenue fell to $383.3 billion in fiscal 2023 from $394.3 billion in fiscal 2022, a decline of 2.8%. Net income followed the same path, easing to $97.0 billion in fiscal 2023 from $99.8 billion in fiscal 2022, also down 2.8%. Operating cash flow weakened more noticeably, falling to $110.5 billion in fiscal 2023 from $122.2 billion in fiscal 2022. The balance sheet, however, improved. Total assets were essentially flat at $352.6 billion in fiscal 2023 against $352.8 billion in fiscal 2022, while total liabilities fell to $290.4 billion from $302.1 billion. Cash and cash equivalents rose to $30.0 billion in fiscal 2023 from $23.6 billion in fiscal 2022. We view fiscal 2023 as a year of soft top-line performance offset by balance sheet improvement.
